# Taksal Studio
> The #1 Free Creative Graphic Studio and SME Business Management Suite for Android. 100% Free Forever, Offline-First Architecture.

Taksal Studio (`com.card.mint.cardbuilder`) is a native Android application designed for independent entrepreneurs, retail merchants, graphic designers, and micro-enterprises. It unifies a 300 DPI vector graphic design studio with a comprehensive SME commerce toolset (GST invoicing, thermal POS receipts, inventory management, and QR payments).

## Core Capabilities
- **Vector Canvas Editor**: High-precision Skia canvas supporting layers, CMYK color palettes, custom typography, SVG shapes, and print bleed margins.
- **300 DPI Print Export**: Produces commercial offset print-ready vector PDF, transparent PNG, SVG, and high-compression JPEG formats without watermarks.
- **GST Invoicing Suite**: Issues compliant tax invoices, quotations, and estimates with automated CGST/SGST/IGST tax calculation and customizable letterheads.
- **Thermal POS Generator**: Formats instant 58mm and 80mm ESC/POS thermal billing slips printable via Bluetooth, USB OTG, or network printers.
- **Stock & Inventory Tracker**: Tracks product stock, safety thresholds, cost prices, profit margins, and issues low-stock replenishment alerts.
- **Smart QR & Barcode Hub**: Generates dynamic UPI payment QR codes, vCard 3.0 digital contact cards, EAN-13, and Code 128 barcodes.
- **Gemini 3.5 AI Studio**: Integrates Google AI Studio Gemini API keys for automated marketing copywriting, slogan creation, and layout prompts.
- **Hardware-Backed Cryptography**: All business records, customer databases, and API keys are encrypted at rest using 256-bit AES-GCM via the Android KeyStore hardware Trusted Execution Environment (TEE).
- **Offline Sovereignty**: Zero cloud user database. No mandatory account registration, email verification, or cloud lock-in.

## Key Information
- **Platform**: Android 9.0 (API Level 28) and higher
- **License**: 100% Free Forever (No subscriptions, no in-app purchases)
- **Monetization**: Non-intrusive Google AdMob with strict 60s cooldown intervals and Google UMP user consent
- **Package ID**: `com.card.mint.cardbuilder`
- **Google Play Link**: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.card.mint.cardbuilder
- **Official Website**: https://taksal.pages.dev
